doc: Domain model + collision/compatibility engines + BOM/cut-list architecture + master study order.
note: Guide for ARCHITECTING the software. Do not scatter corner exceptions; do not maintain BOM independently; keep all domain objects separate.

examples_of_confusion_to_avoid: A door is NOT a cabinet
A drawer is NOT merely a front
An oven is NOT a cabinet
A Gola profile is NOT decoration (it is physical geometry)
A LeMans is NOT an image (it occupies space)

collision_engine.provenance: Blum's own configurator performs collision checks during cabinet planning — a proven professional feature, not overengineering.

accessory_compatibility_engine.rule: The software should tell the designer what IS possible, not merely allow incorrect geometry.

bom_engine.so: BOM must come FROM the model. Never maintain BOM independently.

validation.principle: A geometrically valid cabinet is not necessarily a structurally valid cabinet (ANSI/KCMA A161.1).

master_study_order.week1: PHYSICAL CABINET (fabricate; disassemble METOD; build base/wall/tall; backs/plinths/shelves/stretchers; explain System 32)
master_study_order.week2: FRONTS + HARDWARE (doors; overlay/inset/gaps; hinges + drilling; wood drawers; metal drawers; drawer-front calc)
master_study_order.week3: REAL KITCHENS (sink; hob+hood; oven+microwave tower; fridge housing; pantry; corners; islands + fillers)
master_study_order.week4: ACCESSORIES (bottle/spice pull-outs; bins; LeMans/corners; tall pull-outs; lift-up doors; gola; lighting/open/glass)
master_study_order.week5: WARDROBES (carcasses; hinged doors; sliding doors; short/long/double hanging; drawers+shelves; shoes/trousers/jewellery; lifts)
master_study_order.week6: INSTALLATION + MANUFACTURING (measure; walls+fillers; levelling; wall fixing; services; cut list+edging; drilling+CNC)

final_exam.kitchen: 3500x4000 room, door/window/water/waste/electrical/gas. Design complete kitchen -> room model, cabinet layout, cabinet list, carcass, fronts, drawers, hinges, appliances, accessories, fillers, plinth, end panels, worktop, BOM, cut list, edge list, machining list, hardware list, installation drawings, DXF/CNC.
final_exam.wardrobe: 3000 W x 600 D x 2600 H wardrobe space -> carcasses, hinged/sliding doors, double hanging, long hanging, drawers, shelves, shoe racks, accessories, fillers, end panels, hardware, BOM, manufacturing output.
